# Alpha Research

> Alpha Academic Research Consultants (brand: Alpha Research) is an academic research consultancy — a joint venture by IIM and IIT alumni under Olasco Ventures India Pvt. Ltd. We provide end-to-end research support with a guarantee of zero plagiarism and zero AI detection (100% human-written content).

## What we help with

- Thesis assistance, thesis preparation, thesis content development, and thesis writing
- PhD and Masters dissertation help
- PhD synopsis and research proposal writing
- Thesis chapters (literature review, methodology, results, discussion)
- Thesis statistics and statistical data analysis (SPSS, MATLAB, R, Python)
- Manuscript preparation and manuscript publication
- Research paper writing and academic content preparation
- Journal publication help and thesis publication support
- Publication in Scopus, SCI/SCIE, IEEE, PubMed, and ABDC indexed journals
- Academic editing, proofreading, and formatting (LaTeX, IEEE, APA, MLA, Harvard)
- Engineering simulation support (ANSYS, CFD, Simulink)

## Subject domains we cover

Management, Finance, Human Resources (HR/HRM), Logistics & Supply Chain, Marketing, Economics, Medical (MD/MS), Dental (MDS), Homeopathy & AYUSH, Nursing, Pharmacy, and Engineering — including Mechanical, Electronics & Communication, Applied Electronics, Computer Science, Civil, Electrical, and Biotechnology.

## Service area

We support research scholars across all 28 states of India and their districts — including Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Maharashtra, Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal, Punjab, Haryana, and the North-Eastern states — as well as internationally in the UAE, USA, UK, Australia, Canada, Malta, Austria, Germany and other European Union countries, and across Africa.
